salespeople who perceive that they are given more price authority by their firms tend to have more positive perceptions of their firms’ overall performance.

Salespeople who perceive that they have the highest degree of PA, and who also perceive that the firm’s performance is high (i.e., high sales, high profitability, high market share) are most likely to be satisfied with their jobs and to be committed to the firm.
sales force members who have a greater degree of perceived price authority are more satisfied with their jobs and more likely to remain employed by their firms.
